status: development analysis on eight previously used sources
base: The unchanged, persistent-background plus Z63 empirical-transition sequence for each original source/seed
paired_conditions: base + 0.3 DN constant on each CFA
h: Center each source's empirical fluctuation over valid centers 6..113; scale independently per CFA so the maximum absolute value over all 120 frames is 0.3 DN
pairing: Reuse geometry, photon and read-noise realizations; apply perturbations before integer quantization
network_output: Sliding seven-frame center at original frames 3..116 for T1 and T7; filter those T1 outputs with the identical seven-frame center rule
common_gain: Mean paired prediction change divided by 0.3 DN, separately by source and CFA
relative_gain: Temporal-centered regression of paired prediction change on paired h, separately by source and CFA over the same 108 centers
calibration: Original alpha and scale formula; estimate on the other seven scenes, freeze, score the eighth; retain the original filter grid and 0.05 aggregate training tolerance
reporting: Report held-out aggregate and per-scene gain differences; call response matched only at the explicitly reported aggregation level and for these finite empirical-shaped probes
